resources.string: the host has no config file %1$s
the host has no basic_ncsa_auth of Squid

the host has neither openssl nor cryptpw to hash the password: the package openssl gives one

%1$s has no user %2$s
a password of BasicAuth of tinyproxy takes letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores alone
the password of the upstream may hold no space, quote, colon or @
the host has no %1$s to take the proxy
the login of the proxy goes into the fields user and password, not into its address
%1$s is no JSON object
the method username needs user.privileged root: Dante reads /etc/shadow as that user
%1$s has no inbound %2$s
the app adds no users to an inbound of %1$s

port %1$s is taken on the host
the example inbound of sing-box on port %1$s has a published password: remove it or give it a password of its own
the link is none of vless://, vmess://, trojan://, ss:// and hy2://
the link names no server, port or secret
the client takes no transport %1$s

the login finds no %1$s on its PATH
the private key of Reality is no 32 bytes of base64url

the client of Xray checks every certificate, and the link gives no pcs to pin this one
